verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page says permissions can be controlled at the workspace (organization), project and repo levels, with granular branch-level and environment-level permissions on top, which covers every level the story names. However, this rests on a single marketing line with no detailed docs, and one community admin report (bitbucket-comm-19) says enterprise cloud admins couldn't stop members from making repos public, a specific permission gap. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of each permission level and its roles, independent hands-on corroboration, evidence of org-level controls such as restricting repo visibility.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can assign granular permissions at organization, project, repository, branch, and environment level

citations.quote: Control permissions at the workspace, project, or repo level, and define granular branch‑level, environment‑level, and package permissions
